mapper.select: SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, t.TRANSACTION_AT AS transactionAt, t.TRANSACTION_CONTENT AS transactionContent, t.EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS category, t.TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS amount, a.INSTITUTION_NAME AS institutionName FROM `TRANSACTION` t LEFT JOIN `ACCOUNT` a ON t.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE t.USER_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.TRANSACTION_AT) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.TRANSACTION_AT) = #{month} AND t.IS_DELETED = FALSE ORDER BY t.TRANSACTION_AT DESC

SELECT EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS category, SUM(TRANSACTION_AMOUNT) AS amount FROM `TRANSACTION` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND YEAR(TRANSACTION_AT) = #{year} AND MONTH(TRANSACTION_AT) = #{month} AND IS_DELETED = FALSE AND TRANSACTION_TYPE IN ('EXPENSE', 'FIXED') GROUP BY EXPENSE_CATEGORY ORDER BY amount DESC
